title: Kulikuwa na buffet ya Kikorea kila siku, na nilichukua tu kile nilichopenda

text.There was a Korean buffet every day, and: Kulikuwa na buffet ya Kikorea kila siku, na nilichukua tu kile nilichopenda
text.One good memory from working in Clark is: Kumbukumbu moja nzuri kutoka kwa kufanya kazi huko Clark ni kwamba chakula kilikuwa kitamu.
text.At the Korean restaurant there was somet: Katika mkahawa wa Kikorea kulikuwa na kitu kama bafe ya Kikorea kila siku, na baadaye nilikuwa nikila kile kilichotolewa katika shule ya lugha.
text.It was delicious. I would take a lot of: Ilikuwa tamu. Ningechukua chakula kingi tu nilichopenda, kama mwani wa Korea. Ilikuwa nzuri sana.
text.The dorm floor was so shiny I could almo: Sakafu ya bweni ilikuwa inang'aa sana hivi kwamba nilikaribia kuona uso wangu ndani yake
text.Clark is called the California of Southe: Clark inaitwa California ya Kusini-mashariki mwa Asia, na inaonekana kama hiyo
